text: Bob Gore, Robert Gore & Associates, Chartered Professional Accountants, reporting on the Auditor General's Office of the City of Toronto - Report on the Results of Applying Specified Auditing Procedures to Financial Information Other Than Financial Statements for the Year Ended December 31, 2023.

City Council on July 24 and 25, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (July 2, 2024) from Robert Gore and Associates on the 2023 Compliance Audit for the Auditor General’s Office of the City of Toronto for information.
